caption_used: The effect of context masking on case tasks grouped by language family, with error bars indicating standard deviation. Six model configurations are compared across nine language families: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The IE-Indic family shows the largest effects overall, with most configurations reaching between 17 and 25, while Uralic and Isolate families show near-zero effects across all models. Notably, IE-Germanic exhibits consistently higher effects than IE-Romance across all configurations, with XLM-B2 reaching approximately 20 in IE-Germanic. The Semitic family displays the widest error bars overall, suggesting high variability, and the mBERT-L2 bars in Semitic reach approximately 15. In IE-Slavic, the B2 variants (mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2) dominate over the L2 and R2 variants, with effects approximately twice as large.
raw_response:
This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks for six different model configurations across nine language families. The horizontal axis represents language family, labeled with categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Six data series are represented by bars of different colors: mBERT-L2 (black), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (red), XLM-R2 (pink), mBERT-B2 (green), and XLM-B2 (teal). For each language family, there are six bars, one for each model configuration, displayed side-by-side. Each bar is accompanied by an error bar indicating standard deviation. The shortest bars are generally found within the Isolate and Uralic families, with values near 0 for all models, while the tallest bars are within the IE-Indic family, reaching approximately 25 for some models. The bars are not explicitly sorted, but are arranged by language family. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
